message: XVatsim 2.0.2 is available. Download the freeware Windows XP12 package from X-Plane.org or GitHub Releases.
release_notes: Keeps controller selection in the Brain with simple yes, no, and neutral evidence votes, including Australian callsign variations and declared coverage extensions.
Monitors xPilot logs for incoming direct private and PDC/ACARS messages while excluding public radio, server, outgoing, and other-callsign traffic.
Stores messages newest first and returns the PDC ORB from amber NEW to cyan IDLE after the pilot leaves the Drawer.
Reduces diagnostic volume with one-minute flight-loop summaries while preserving performance outliers and change-driven Brain receipts.
